title: Allow a compact header above
result: Header rows shorter than the body median no longer produce row-height-scale findings. The existing header-more-than-eight-pixels-taller check and two-pixel body-row spread check remain unchanged. Generic table fixtures and documentation capture the policy without a calendar/library/class exemption; original private-screen acceptance is not claimed.
evidence: The 19px-header/36px-body regression failed before the fix. `pnpm --filter @syntopica/ui-quality exec vitest run tests/rules/tables.test.ts tests/cli.data-display.integration.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passed 36 tests in two files, including the existing 64px/40px tall-header, uneven body, wrapped-row and tolerance controls. Package lint, type-check and build passed; independent review returned no findings.
